text:
oliver: FYI onboarding lab again — Node quickstart floods tenant with 429s when users page embeddings fast.
meera: saw that in logs. sample does naive parallel pagination and our quota bursts.
kai: can you paste the offending line?
oliver: it's basically `await Promise.all(cursors.map(c => client.embeddings.page({ cursor: c })))` — fires too many requests.
meera: + the JS SDK retries have almost no jitter, so failures immediately retry and amplify.
kai: SDK parity: python exposes a public RateLimiter; JS keeps it internal. sample authors can't opt into a shared token-bucket.
oliver: short-term patch: change quickstart to use `p-limit(3)` and add a short "When you see 429s" note. long-term: export a tiny `createRateLimiter({permitsPerSec, burst})` from the JS SDK root.
meera: also auth refresh race: when token refresh starts mid-flight, several requests 401 and all retry, duplicating work. we should singleflight refreshes.
kai: implement `auth.onceRefresh()` or similar that returns the current refresh promise. small change, big win.
oliver: for retries let's standardize on exp backoff + jitter: `base * 2**attempt * (0.7 + Math.random()*0.6)` and cap at 2s client-side.
meera: ergonomics idea: add `concurrency` option to the paginator so samples can keep `for await` pattern but control parallelism: `for await (const p of client.embeddings.paginate(q, { concurrency: 2 })) {}`
kai: agree. also add a lightweight header `x-client-concurrency` so support can correlate.
infra-bot: preview build for quickstart changes: https://deployments.redwood-inference.dev/pr/724
docs-bot: I'll add a checklist item in quickstart: "If you see 429s while paging: lower concurrency, use the SDK RateLimiter, or enable jittered backoff" and add sample code.
oliver: I'll open the sample PR with p-limit fallback now. kai: I'll prepare SDK export PR and auth singleflight later today.
meera: this should cut onboarding tickets and make quickstarts less surprising for new users. :+1:
